blocks.text: This helps frame an interpretive question raised by the passage: Ramesside Qadesh relief compositions depict the royal campaign tent at the center of a bounded military camp; scholars have compared aspects of its plan and centrality with the tabernacle and Israelite camp. The reliefs show mobile royal architecture and camp centrality in New Kingdom Egypt but cannot identify the royal tent as a sanctuary or blueprint for Exodus.
